description:
PERF ROUND 43 member 2 (s513e, Opus, 2026-10-09).  Chosen over `lcbytes` by profile + hand-replaced A/B.

=== DONE (s513e) ===
Profiles (base 462169f6, statprof): subste -- the engine's own matcher closures ~40 %, the generic cl-ppcre:scan dispatch per match ~8-10 % (check-applicable-keywords, emf, the dlisp3 trampoline, return-multiple) and regex-replace-all's assembly through a string output stream ~15 % (string-sout, write-string, get-output-stream-string).  lcbytes -- no frame above 24 %: %p-concat-2 24 % (the nested `.` chain, an EMISSION matter -- not this runtime round), %p-case-map-ascii 19 % (already one pass since #2535), the UTF-8 well-formedness scan 17 %; no runtime lever of comparable size, so lcbytes stays as it is (3.07x).
Fix (runtime only): %p-subst-replace-all drives s///g's loop itself -- perl's global rule through %p-global-scan (after an empty match the next attempt is at the same position under minend, exactly what %p-global-scanner emulated inside cl-ppcre's do-scans), the replacement called per match (the /e arm) or a plain string inserted (a non-/e replacement with no backslash; a template with \N / \& still goes to cl-ppcre), the pieces blitted into one pre-sized string (%p-subst-pieces-string).  The non-/e arm's first-match capture scan uses %p-ppcre-scan (no dispatch) instead of cl-ppcre:scan.
Hand-replaced A/B (scratch/s513e/ab-m2.log, control +-0.8 %): the subste program -41.0 %; lcbytes untouched (+2.3 %, inside noise of its control).
Probe tables: eprobe.pl 26 rows + eprobe2.pl 12 rows: tree == base on all 38; 36 == perl; 2 pre-existing (pos() inside s///ge = #1457; `^` under /m after a trailing newline = NEW #2982).
Guard Pl/t/perf-levers-12.t rows 5-7 (mechanism: empty-match rule + count + NIL on no match; two answer tables); no timed row -- the lever is ~1.5x on a whole program (1.03 s vs 1.55 s), not separable from CI noise.  Row 5 fails on the base extraction (inverse).


FOLLOW-UP (s513e second resume): the first build left cl-ppcre's *real-start-pos* unbound around each scan, so lookbehind, \b/\B and ^ read the attempt position as the string start (re/subst.t -6 rows in the companion); fixed in 07432289 by binding it to 0 around the scan only, guard perf-levers-12.t row 8.  Review (00bafd71): the replacement pieces are copied with %pcl-str-blit, measured +2.6 % on subste alone.  Final table: subste 0.1825 -> 0.1101 s (3.35x -> 2.02x perl).
subject: PERF: s///g is driven by cl-ppcre's regex-replace-all -- a generic SCAN dispatch per match and a string-output-stream assembly (subste 3.3x perl)
